intelligence.enrichment: Sexual reproduction involves two parents and specialised reproductive cells called gametes; each gamete carries half of a parent's genetic material, and joining male and female gametes forms a new cell with a complete mix of genetic information. half-material gametes from two parents -> fertilisation -> complete mixed genetic information -> offspring similarity and difference The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Sexual reproduction involves two parents and specialised reproductive cells called gametes; each gamete carries half of a parent's genetic material, and joining male and female gametes forms a new cell with a complete mix of genetic information. A baby simply receives a full instruction manual from each parent, so the amount of genetic material doubles each generation.
